cases.sentence: Но ___ отказался и сказал, «Я знаю, мой сын, я знаю».
cases.explain: Отец is the subject of the verb отказался, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Поэтому я похоронил ее там, у ___ в Ефрафу, то есть в Вифлеем.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by/near) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Да сделает тебя бог подобным ___ и Монассии».
cases.explain: The adjective подобный (like) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Но Израиль протянул правую руку и возложил ее на ___ Ефрема, хотя он и был младше.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating placement onto governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я отдаю тебе... лишний горный кряж, который я отвоевал у Амореев ___ и луком.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means: он отвоевал (чем?) мечом — took it with a sword.

cases.sentence: Бог Всемогущий явился мне в Лузе, в ___ Ханаана, благословил меня.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Некоторое время спустя Иосифу сказали, «Твой отец болен», и он взял с собой двух сыновей, Монассию и Ефрема.
reading.question: Why did Joseph go to see his father, taking his two sons along?
options: Because he was told his father was sick
Because his father demanded a feast
reading.correct: Because he was told his father was sick
reading.explain: Joseph was told his father was sick, so he took his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, with him.

reading.ru: Отныне двое твоих сыновей, рожденных тебе в Египте до моего прихода, станут моими».
reading.question: What did Jacob (Israel) claim regarding Joseph's two sons?
options: That they would become his own, like Reuben and Simeon
That they must return to Canaan
reading.correct: That they would become his own, like Reuben and Simeon
reading.explain: Jacob says Joseph's two sons, born in Egypt, will become his own, like Reuben and Simeon.

reading.ru: Рахиль, горю моему, умерла в земле Ханаана, когда мы были еще в пути недалеко от Ефрафы.
reading.question: What did Jacob recall about Rachel?
options: She died on the way near Ephrath
She lived to see Joseph's sons
reading.correct: She died on the way near Ephrath
reading.explain: Jacob recalls that Rachel died in the land of Canaan, on the way, near Ephrath.

reading.ru: Глаза Израиля ослабли от старости, он почти ослеп.
reading.question: What physical condition affected Israel (Jacob) in his old age?
options: His eyes were weak and he was nearly blind
reading.correct: His eyes were weak and he was nearly blind
reading.explain: Israel's eyes had grown weak with age, so that he was nearly blind.

reading.ru: Но Израиль протянул правую руку и возложил ее на голову Ефрема, хотя он и был младше, а левую, перекрестив руки, он возложил на голову Монассии, хотя Монассия был первенцем.
reading.question: How did Israel cross his hands when blessing his grandsons?
options: He put his right hand on Ephraim (the younger) and his left on Manasseh (the firstborn)
He put his right hand on Manasseh and his left on Ephraim
He refused to bless either of them
reading.correct: He put his right hand on Ephraim (the younger) and his left on Manasseh (the firstborn)
reading.explain: Israel crossed his hands, putting his right hand on the younger Ephraim and his left on the firstborn Manasseh.

reading.ru: От него тоже произойдет народ, и он тоже станет велик, но его младший брат будет выше него, и его потомки станут множеством народов.
reading.question: What did Israel say about Manasseh compared to his younger brother Ephraim?
options: That his younger brother would be greater than him
That Manasseh would have no descendants
reading.correct: That his younger brother would be greater than him
reading.explain: Israel says that although Manasseh will become a people, his younger brother will be greater than he.

reading.ru: Я отдаю тебе, как высшему среди братьев, лишний горный кряж, который я отвоевал у Амореев мечом и луком.
reading.question: What extra gift did Israel give to Joseph beyond his brothers?
options: An extra mountain ridge taken from the Amorites
A plot of land in Egypt
reading.correct: An extra mountain ridge taken from the Amorites
reading.explain: Israel gives Joseph an extra mountain ridge that he took from the Amorites with sword and bow.
